name: TickTick
description: TickTick is a to-do list and calendar app that helps users capture ideas, organize tasks, and manage time with multiple planning views, habit tracking, and built-in focus tools, syncing in real time across devices.
best_for: Positioned for individuals who want a to-do list combined with calendar planning, habit tracking, and time-blocking in one free-to-start app.
features: Multiple calendar views: yearly, monthly, weekly, daily, and agenda
Kanban boards, timeline view, and Eisenhower Matrix for prioritization
Built-in Pomodoro timer for focus sessions
Habit tracker with statistics and flexible tracking options
Natural language processing for automatic date and time recognition
Task sharing and assignment for collaboration

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.description: A cross-platform task manager with natural-language scheduling, projects, and collaboration features.
alternatives.best_for: Users who want a streamlined task manager without built-in habit tracking

alternatives.name: Things
alternatives.description: A personal task manager for Apple devices with projects, areas, and a one-time purchase price.
alternatives.best_for: Apple users who prefer a one-time purchase over a subscription
